study_identification_part.si4_title: Beyond homogeneity: charting the landscape of heterogeneity in neurodevelopmental and psychiatric electroencephalography

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Combine high-density EEG with normative modeling to quantify individual-level heterogeneity in spectral power and source-space functional connectivity across ADHD, ASD, anxiety, and learning disorder, and relate deviation metrics to group differences and clinical measures.

rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.reason: Methods and Code availability describe the core processing steps and software: Welch PSD, eLORETA source estimation with BEM in MNE, DK atlas downsampling to 68 ROIs, AEC with orthogonalization for leakage, BrainNet Viewer for networks, and NBS for comparisons.

Desikan–Killiany atlas ... functional connectivity ... using the amplitude envelope correlation (AEC) ... Zero-lag signal overlaps ... removed using a pairwise orthogonalization ..."; "EEG signal processing is done using the MNE-python package ... Networks are visualized using BrainNet Viewer ... rci8_quality_checking.supporting_text: "Electrode impedance checks were performed before recording, and values were maintained below 40 kΩ."; "electrode impedance was assessed before each recording, ensuring it remained below 100 kΩ."

nm6_predictor_effects.answer: Age modeled with fractional polynomials in GAMLSS (nonlinear effects); no hierarchical/site random effects specified in final models
nm6_predictor_effects.reason: They adopt fractional polynomials to capture nonlinearity (per Bethlehem et al.). While the GAMLSS framework allows random effects, the study specifies age as the main covariate and does not indicate inclusion of site-level random effects in the fitted models.
nm6_predictor_effects.supporting_text: "Bethlehem et al. use fractional polynomials as the smoothing function ... and we adopt the same approach."; "In this study, our response variable is an EEG-derived feature and the main covariate is age."

nm7_nm_vldtn_handle_ns.reason: The approach addresses several nuisance structures: age nonlinearity (fractional polynomials), distributional shape and heteroscedasticity (GAMLSS models μ/σ/ν/τ), and source leakage (orthogonalization). However, no explicit harmonization or site/scanner effects handling (e.g., ComBat or hierarchical site effects) is reported.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Network-based statistics (NBS, permutation n=5000) for group comparisons using deviation scores vs original features; correlation of global deviation score with ADOS total in ASD.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Deviation patterns are highly heterogeneous and frequency-dependent with low spatial overlap; deviation-based analyses enhance group differentiation; global deviation correlates with clinical assessment (ADOS).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Deviation spatial overlap across patients did not exceed 40% (spectral) and 24% (connectivity); negative deviation counts differed from HC(test) in delta; positive deviations differed in alpha/beta across groups; connectivity deviations showed group- and band-specific patterns; deviation-based NBS contrasts revealed differences beyond original features; global deviation scores correlated with ADOS in ASD.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Applied normative modeling to EEG spectral/connectivity features to derive subject-specific deviation maps in four neurodevelopmental/psychiatric groups; evaluated extreme deviations and overlap; related deviations to clinical measures (ADOS).

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Publication year is 2025 (Translational Psychiatry), though local filename uses 2024. Healthy controls split into training (n=448) and held-out test (n=112). No explicit site/scanner harmonization reported; models used age as the main covariate with fractional polynomials in GAMLSS; leakage correction applied for connectivity. Acquisition QC included impedance thresholds; explicit exclusion counts not reported. Analyses conducted at electrode (scalp) and ROI/network (source) levels.
